description.text: The other fifth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Ultra Sun on 8 December 2017. Dawn Wings Necrozma made its card debut as a Pokémon-GX, and Ultra Moon's Sinnoh cards include Piplup, Glaceon-GX, Palkia-GX, Volkner with Luxray, and Cynthia with Lucario and Garchomp. The packs introduced Prism Star cards, of which a deck may hold only one of each name; Ultra Moon's are Lunala, Giratina and Super Boost Energy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Cynthia, Volkner and Looker, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Crushing Hammer, Escape Board and Unit Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Ultra Prism in February 2018.
